summary: Backend-only integration testing of the Wix subscription-linking flow, Stripe-hidden path, and auth guards. 16/17 tests pass. All requested scenarios verified: (1) Wix sync auth guard rejects missing/wrong secret with 401 and reaches the DB layer (503 'Supabase not configured') with correct secret via either 'X-Wix-Sync-Secret' or 'Authorization: Bearer ...'; (2) Pydantic email validation fires (422) on bad email; (3) /auth/api-key behaves the same; (4) Stripe endpoints return 503 (never 500); (5) startup logs the active plan->tier mapping. One minor deviation: GET /api/v1/user/me returns 422 (missing header) instead of 401/403 when Authorization is absent.

minor.issue: Returns 422 (Pydantic 'header authorization required') when Authorization header is missing, instead of a proper 401/403. Root cause: `get_current_user(authorization: str = Header(...))` in app/dependencies.py declares the header as required, so Pydantic validates before the auth logic runs. Fix: change signature to `authorization: str | None = Header(default=None)` and raise HTTPException(401) inside the function when it's missing. Same pattern likely applies to any other route depending on get_current_user.

action_items: Optional: in app/dependencies.py:get_current_user, make the Authorization header optional (Header(default=None)) and raise HTTPException(401, 'Missing authorization header') inside the function body, so unauth calls return 401 instead of a Pydantic 422. This affects every endpoint depending on get_current_user.
critical_code_review_comments: app/routers/billing.py line 461: `raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Database error")` is missing `from e` — loses exception chaining (linter warn). Cosmetic.

backend/tests/conftest.py sets SUPABASE_URL/keys via os.environ.setdefault at import time to satisfy get_settings(). Fine, but keep in mind the deployed backend/.env has SUPABASE_URL empty on purpose — that is why every DB-reaching request returns 503, which is the intended sandbox behavior.
app/main.py uses deprecated `@application.on_event('startup')` (deprecation warning). Migrate to lifespan handler when convenient.
auth.py:92-97: bare `except Exception` around the initial user lookup silently swallows any non-Postgrest error, only logging a warning. Consider narrowing or re-raising for observability.
billing.py `_verify_wix_sync_secret` and auth.py `_verify_wix_secret` are near-duplicate helpers (DRY). Consider extracting into a shared dependency in app/dependencies.py.
billing.py _WIX_PLAN_NAME_TO_TIER / _WIX_KEYWORD_TO_TIER refactor looks clean; startup log confirms mapping is active (verified in backend logs).
test_credentials: WIX_SYNC_SECRET=test-secret-123 (from backend/.env). No user login credentials — Supabase intentionally disabled in this sandbox.
seed_data_creation: None. Supabase not configured, so no DB writes were possible; tests only verify auth/guard/validation layers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: This is a backend-only Wix billing flow. External URL routes only /api/* to backend:8001; /health and / are NOT reachable externally (they route to frontend:3000 which is in FATAL state — not a concern per the review request). Test file /app/backend/tests/test_wix_billing_integration.py hits /health via http://localhost:8001 and everything else via the external preview URL. Every DB-touching endpoint returns 503 'Supabase not configured' — that is the expected sandbox behavior and is treated as PASS for auth-guard verification. Do NOT try to seed users or issue real API keys — Supabase is intentionally off. Startup log line to look for in /var/log/supervisor/backend.*.log: 'Wix plan->tier mapping active' (confirmed present with keywords/plan_names populated).

rca of the issue.user_reported_issue: Wix Velo calls to /billing/wix/sync were silently failing — user's plan tier never updated on the backend.
rca of the issue.root_cause_verified_by_tests: The /api/v1/billing/wix/sync guard `_verify_wix_sync_secret` rejects wrong or missing secret with HTTP 401 'Invalid Wix sync secret' / 'Missing Wix sync auth'. If Wix Velo was sending the wrong secret (or none), it would silently 401 on the client side. The current implementation correctly (a) accepts secret via `X-Wix-Sync-Secret: <secret>` header AND `Authorization: Bearer <secret>`, (b) proceeds past the guard to the DB call when the secret matches, and (c) refactored `_wix_plan_to_tier` to editable mapping tables (verified via startup log dump).
rca of the issue.reproduction: 1) POST /api/v1/billing/wix/sync with no header -> 401 'Missing Wix sync auth'. 2) With header 'X-Wix-Sync-Secret: wrong' -> 401 'Invalid Wix sync secret'. 3) With correct secret -> reaches DB (503 Supabase-not-configured in this sandbox; would succeed in prod).
rca of the issue.mitigation: User should ensure Wix Velo sets header `X-Wix-Sync-Secret` (or `Authorization: Bearer`) exactly matching WIX_SYNC_SECRET in backend/.env. The 401 response body already contains a clear 'Invalid Wix sync secret' detail — Wix Velo should log that response to surface the issue instead of silently failing.
